decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that closely fits the firm's stated direction and core capabilities, it is a low-cost option to keep open and unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

This organic poultry snack is still close enough to the firm's charcuterie base to justify keeping it on the market while demand becomes clearer, though its niche positioning makes withdrawal somewhat more plausible than for the flagship line.

The premium sharing snack extends the existing salami business with limited additional uncertainty and manageable carrying cost, so management would likely continue it rather than abandon it after only one year.
